uspto-raw.name: USPTO · Lowe patent reactions
uspto-raw.description: Reaction corpus extracted from US patents, used in reaction prediction and derived retrosynthesis datasets.
uspto-raw.notes: The patents span 1976 to September 2016. USPTO-50k and USPTO-Full share this source and all count as one family. Record counts and data licenses require verification for each edition.

uspto-50k.name: USPTO-50k
uspto-50k.description: A widely used single-step retrosynthesis dataset covering about 50,000 reactions in ten classes.
uspto-50k.notes: The name “50k” identifies the edition. The exact current count and the separate licenses for software and data require verification.

uspto-full.name: USPTO-Full · GLN edition
uspto-full.description: GLN provides a cleaning, deduplication and splitting pipeline for large-scale single-step retrosynthesis.
uspto-full.notes: Counts depend on the processed edition and split. Reactions may overlap across USPTO editions.

paroutes.name: PaRoutes
paroutes.description: A framework for evaluating multistep retrosynthesis, with reference routes and evaluation tools.
paroutes.notes: The n1 and n5 sets each contain 10,000 routes and may overlap. Their combined unique count is unknown. PaRoutes counts as one benchmark suite.

ord.name: Open Reaction Database
ord.description: An open collection of reaction data with a standard schema that supports reaction-specific subsets.
ord.notes: Counted as one ongoing database. Individual Dataset files share this database, and dedicated coupling and heterocycle subsets still need curation.

buchwald-hartwig.name: Buchwald–Hartwig HTE
buchwald-hartwig.description: High-throughput C–N coupling experiments from Ahneman and the Doyle group, widely used in yield prediction.
buchwald-hartwig.notes: Processed tables and the full experiment and control records use different counting conventions. The exact count remains unverified. The heterocycle tag refers to additives.

suzuki-hte.name: Suzuki–Miyaura HTE · Perera
suzuki-hte.description: High-throughput Suzuki–Miyaura C–C coupling experiments on a flow chemistry platform.
suzuki-hte.notes: Processed files may share a repository with Buchwald–Hartwig HTE. The two collections come from distinct experimental campaigns.
suzuki-hte.count_note: Experiment count reported in the original paper.

direct-arylation.name: Direct Arylation · EDBO
direct-arylation.description: Imidazole C–H arylation data from Shields and colleagues for Bayesian reaction optimization.
direct-arylation.notes: The data accompany the EDBO optimization software. Only the dataset contributes to the family count.
direct-arylation.count_note: A 12 × 4 × 4 × 3 × 3 experimental grid gives 1,728 conditions within this reaction study.

denmark-selectivity.name: Denmark · CPA selectivity
denmark-selectivity.description: Selectivity data for modeling N,S-acetal reactions catalyzed by chiral phosphoric acids.
denmark-selectivity.notes: ΔΔG‡ measures the difference between activation free energies associated with selectivity. Thermodynamic reaction ΔG is a separate quantity. Conversions involving ee require temperature and sign conventions.
denmark-selectivity.count_note: 43 × 25 combinations yield 1,075 means from 2,150 individual replicate experiments.

sad.name: Sharpless Asymmetric Dihydroxylation
sad.description: Open asymmetric dihydroxylation data and associated tools from the Denmark group.
sad.notes: Record count and data license await verification. The repository license covers software separately.

rgd1.name: RGD1
rgd1.description: Computed reaction data with reactants, products, transition states and Gibbs free energies.
rgd1.notes: Use the definitions of R_F, P_F and TS_F together with the corresponding temperature and level of theory.
rgd1.count_note: The group reports the reaction count and, separately, 176,992 transition states.

freesolv.name: FreeSolv
freesolv.description: Measured and computed small-molecule hydration free energies, with simulation input files.
freesolv.notes: Hydration free energy and reaction free energy represent distinct prediction tasks.

sampl6.name: SAMPL6 · Host–Guest / SAMPLing
sampl6.description: Blind challenges and public results for host–guest binding free energies and sampling methods.
sampl6.notes: SAMPL6 counts as one challenge suite. Each round and subtask has its own scope.

matbench.name: Matbench
matbench.description: Standardized datasets and cross-validation protocols for machine learning on materials properties.
matbench.notes: Version 0.1 contains 13 tasks, each with its own samples and units. Matbench counts as one benchmark suite.

matbench-discovery.name: Matbench Discovery
matbench-discovery.description: A benchmark for testing whether machine-learned energy models can identify stable inorganic crystals.
matbench-discovery.notes: This suite is distinct from Matbench. Its underlying records may overlap with Materials Project data.

tdc.name: Therapeutics Data Commons
tdc.description: Data loading, splitting and evaluation for drug discovery tasks.
tdc.notes: Counted as one suite. Sources, splits, metrics and licenses still require review for each subtask.

chembl.name: ChEMBL
chembl.description: A curated database of compounds, biological activities, targets and assays.
chembl.notes: The historical series uses activity counts from individual EMBL-EBI release notes.

bindingdb.name: BindingDB
bindingdb.description: Molecular binding measurements for affinity and drug activity prediction.
bindingdb.notes: Endpoints, assay conditions and measurement units need harmonization before pooling. The license and exact snapshot still require verification.

indpensim.name: IndPenSim · Industrial penicillin fermentation
indpensim.description: Simulated process and Raman data for industrial-scale penicillin fed-batch fermentation in a 100,000 L vessel.
indpensim.notes: Counted as one dataset family. The monitor tracks commits to the author’s notebook. Mendeley dataset releases require separate verification.
indpensim.count_note: Mendeley v2, October 8, 2019. These batches were generated by simulation.

erythromycin-efp.name: EFP · Industrial erythromycin fermentation
erythromycin-efp.description: Production measurements from Yichang HEC Changjiang Pharmaceutical in 2022, with 23 process variables sampled hourly.
erythromycin-efp.notes: The prediction target is chemical potency. Yield, productivity and downstream purification labels remain unverified. The data license was checked against the Zenodo API.
erythromycin-efp.count_note: Zenodo v1. The 406 batches average 154 hours each, with several observations per batch.

steroid-binding-1981.name: Dunn · Steroid binding affinities
steroid-binding-1981.description: The original paper reports binding affinities for 21 endogenous steroids and two human plasma carrier proteins.
steroid-binding-1981.notes: The timeline follows the verified paper year. Each steroid has multiple binding endpoints.
steroid-binding-1981.data_origin: Experimental tables in the original paper

comfa-steroids.name: CoMFA · Steroid QSAR benchmark
comfa-steroids.description: Cramer and colleagues tested three-dimensional QSAR predictions against steroid binding activities. The paper identifies the modeling and prediction sets.
comfa-steroids.notes: This early evaluation set may share compounds with steroid affinity experiments and counts as one benchmark suite.
comfa-steroids.data_origin: Experimental evaluation set in the original paper

tecr-oxidoreductases.name: NIST · Oxidoreductase reaction equilibria
tecr-oxidoreductases.description: Goldberg and colleagues compiled equilibrium constants and enthalpies for enzyme-catalyzed reactions, with measurement conditions.
tecr-oxidoreductases.notes: Part one of the 1993 series. Conversion from K′ to standard transformed Gibbs free energy requires temperature, pH and other measurement conditions.

dud.name: DUD · Virtual screening benchmark
dud.description: Known ligands and matched decoys for evaluating enrichment by docking methods.

dude.name: DUD-E · Virtual screening benchmark
dude.description: A rebuilt DUD evaluation suite covering 102 targets.
dude.notes: DUD-E reconstructs the tasks and decoys and counts as a separately named benchmark suite.

uspto-2014.name: USPTO · Lowe 2014 release
uspto-2014.description: The author released reactions extracted from US patents and applications, then published an expanded version in 2017.
uspto-2014.notes: The author announced this release on February 27, 2014. This date and the earliest patent year refer to different events.

retro-star-190.name: Retro* · 190 multistep planning targets
retro-star-190.description: Multistep retrosynthesis test problems released by Chen and colleagues with Retro*.
retro-star-190.notes: The underlying reactions come from USPTO. This collection counts once as a test suite.

omat24.name: OMat24 · Inorganic materials calculations
omat24.description: Inorganic crystal structures and DFT data from FAIR Chemistry for energy, force and stress prediction.
omat24.notes: The 2024 preprint and the authors’ Hugging Face dataset card refer to the same resource.

csd.name: Cambridge Structural Database
csd.description: Organic and metal-organic small-molecule crystal structures compiled by CCDC. Its publication-year series includes records predating the database.
csd.notes: The database was founded in 1965 and incorporates literature dating to 1923. CCDC sets separate access terms for public statistics and the full structure database.

heifets-planning.name: Heifets–Jurisica · Synthesis planning problems
heifets-planning.description: Organic synthesis planning problems and evaluation code released by the authors with their AAAI 2012 paper.

retrotransformdb.name: RetroTransformDB
retrotransformdb.description: General retrosynthetic transformation rules validated by organic chemistry experts.
retrotransformdb.notes: Counted as a rule set. A general transformation rule can cover multiple experimental instances.

het-retro-cjhif.name: Het-retro · CJHIF heterocycle formation subset
het-retro-cjhif.description: Journal-derived heterocycle formation records curated by the authors for single-step retrosynthesis.
het-retro-cjhif.notes: This entry covers the CJHIF ring formation subset. The general USPTO training set in the same repository belongs to the USPTO family. Ring formation includes reactions outside the coupling category.

absynth.name: AbSynth · Total synthesis routes
absynth.description: Machine-readable routes curated retrospectively from classic total syntheses for analysis of synthetic strategy.
absynth.notes: The authors distribute the data via Allchemy to verified research institutions. The resource publication date and the dates of the historical routes are tracked separately.

chembench.name: ChemBench
chembench.description: General chemistry knowledge and reasoning evaluation for language models.
chembench.notes: The first preprint appeared in 2024. Framework commits do not imply question growth; the multimodal extension is not counted separately.
chembench.count_note: 2025 Nature Chemistry paper edition; not a live question count.

chemiq.name: ChemIQ
chemiq.description: Short-answer evaluation of molecular understanding, reaction reasoning and NMR elucidation.
chemiq.notes: First public preprint: 2025; journal volume: 2026. Additional error-analysis questions are excluded from the 816 questions.
chemiq.count_note: Current main question set in the author repository; NMR questions updated in July 2025.

chemtoolbench.name: ChemToolBench
chemtoolbench.description: Chemistry and materials tool-selection, parameter-filling and multistep tool-use evaluation released with CheMatAgent.
chemtoolbench.notes: Includes training and evaluation splits; training samples are not counted as test questions.

compchembench.name: CompChemBench
compchembench.description: Evaluates agents preparing inputs, running simulations, analyzing outputs and repairing computational chemistry workflows.
compchembench.notes: Uses Terminal-Bench / Harbor format. Year is supported by the author repository created in 2026. Catalog review does not mean the tasks were rerun; data licenses require per-item verification.
compchembench.count_note: 46 tasks declared in the author v1.1 data card, not an independently measured pass count.

oprd-target.name: OPRD-target
oprd-target.description: Manufacturing chemistry targets and source-paper DOIs for retrosynthesis evaluation.
oprd-target.notes: Provides target structures and citations, not digitized routes. A molecule can link to multiple papers. Year follows the author repository created in 2026.
oprd-target.count_note: 2,219 unique targets reported by the authors; 1997–2022 is the literature period, not the release year.

cheminsight.name: ChemInsight
cheminsight.description: Evaluates structured chemistry understanding and multistep reasoning with scope and depth scores.
cheminsight.notes: Paper verified; a separate data download and data license remain unconfirmed. No upstream data-revision monitor is configured.
cheminsight.count_note: November 9, 2026 preprint: 203 questions in 50 bundles; these units are not summed.

deltascience.name: DeltaScience · Chemistry tasks
deltascience.description: Bohrium executable scientific-agent evaluation platform with drug design, retrosynthesis, computational chemistry and cheminformatics tasks.
deltascience.notes: Counted as one suite, not one per chemistry task. Live details in deltascience.json use the official primary Chemistry category; cross-disciplinary tags may cover more tasks. Year denotes first verification in 2026, not a confirmed first release. Download conditions and data licenses require per-task review.
